text.en:
When a Melee Ability Charge is consumed:
Grants Melee Ability Energy based on the number of Mods equipped and consumes active Armor Charge Stacks.  

Each Stack of Armor Charge is the equivalent of an additional Kickstart Mod.

Ability Energy gains with 1|2|etc. Mods equipped:
<pve/>12.8% | 17.1% | 23.3% | 30.8% | 37.7% | 42.3% | 45.7% | 48.1% | 49.9%
<pvp/>Ability Energy gains are halved in PVP.

When a Melee Ability Charge is fully consumed:
Grants Melee Ability Energy based on the number of Mods equipped and consumes active Armor Charge Stacks.  

Each Stack of Armor Charge is the equivalent of an additional Kickstart Mod.

Ability Energy gains with 1|2|etc. Mods:
<pve/>[PVE] 12.9% | 17.15% | 23.4% | 31% | 37.8% | 42.5% | 45.8% | 48.2% | 50%
<pvp/>[PVP] 11.3% | 12.9% | 14.8% | 17.15% | 20% | 23.4% | 27.15% | 31% | 34.65%

When a Melee Ability Charge is fully consumed:
Grants Melee Ability Energy based on the number of Mods equipped and consumes active Armor Charge Stacks.  

Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Melee Energy refunds.

Melee Energy gains with 1|2|etc. 'charges':
<pve/>[PVE] 12.9% | 17.15% | 23.4% | 31% | 37.8% | 42.5% | 45.8% | 48.2% | 50%
<pvp/>[PVP] 11.3% | 12.9% | 14.8% | 17.15% | 20% | 23.4% | 27.15% | 31% | 34.65%

Bugged: Doesn't work with multiple Melee Charges.

When a Melee Ability Charge is fully consumed and you have active Armor Charges:
Consumes active Armor Charges and grants Melee Ability Energy.  

Each Mod and Stack of Armor Charge counts as one 'charge' for Melee Energy refunds.

Melee Energy gains with 2|3|etc. 'charges':
<pve/>[PVE] 16.2% | 21.7% | 28.4% | 34.4% | 38.4% | 41.3% | 43.4% | 45%
<pvp/>[PVP] 12.5% | 14.2% | 16.2% | 18.7% | 21.7% | 25% | 28.4% | 31.6%

Bug: Doesn't work if you have more recharged Melee Ability Energy than a single ability charge.
